description: Use first when the user names a brand, a market or something buyers ask AI. Returns matching brands, topics and markets from Parse's public index: brands and topics each with a fetch id (brand:<slug>, topic:<industry/market/topic>), markets with a link to their page. Next: parse_check_brand for one brand's standing, parse_get_brand for its full brief, or parse_get_topic for the brands AI mentions on one topic.

query.description: A brand name, a website, a market, a topic or a question.

types.description: Which kinds to return; omit for all three. `niches` are markets. `prompts`, the old name for questions, returns topics.

name: parse_search
title: Search Parse AI visibility data
